Your recorded readings will appear here. Export them before closing this page.

Contact moment = (reading − baseline) × 0.00980665 × arm in metres. Arm gravity and gearbox friction are not corrected. This static test does not measure gearbox efficiency or prove maximum torque.

Quick bench procedure +
  1. Flash the matching firmware, connect the board by USB, and select its ST-LINK serial port.
  2. Keep the arm clear of the scale. Verify which direction moves toward contact, then approach slowly.
  3. Stop at light contact, set a reference, and enter the baseline scale reading and measured moment arm.
  4. Start slow loading. Stop and hold at the chosen reading; record it, then reverse to unload.

The board stops motion if the connection lease expires, the physical blue button is pressed, or a travel/time budget is reached. It cannot detect stall, force, or scale overload. Voltage and the driver's current DIP setting remain fixed.
